name: RAPOSA
def: Portuguese remotely operated search and rescue robot built to work in dangerous outdoor areas such as the rubble of collapsed structures and detect victims with its sensors.
facts: Measures 75 cm long, 37 cm wide and 17.5 cm high, weighing 27 kg
Sensor options include a thermal camera, explosive and toxic gas sensors and inclinometers
Currently fitted for searching only, not for rescue
